instructions: Query layer over the cngx (@cngx/*) public API. Answers ground against cngx 0.1.0-rc.6 (snapshot 2026-08-17T11:21:23.588Z, schemaVersion 2). Confirm the consuming app runs a matching cngx release before relying on an answer, or pass an optional version argument to ground a query against another release. The eight query tools are read-only and answer offline by default; find_component, get_api, get_slots, get_theme_tokens, get_di_tokens, and get_config accept an optional version that - when it differs from the bundled snapshot - fetches that release snapshot via the gh CLI, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe: no network or an absent asset returns a typed { ok: false, reason }) and answers as { ok: true, groundedVersion, result }. migrate_usage additionally answers cross-version deltas over the same fetch. The server also serves resources (browse: cngx://catalog, cngx://tokens, cngx://provenance, the cngx://api/{name} template, the cngx://llms index and the cngx://llms-full API dump) and prompts (wire_component, theme_component, migrate_cngx) - all three MCP surface types over the same offline snapshot.

tools.name: find_component
tools.title: Find cngx component, directive, or service
tools.description: Search cngx components, directives, and injectable services by name, selector, or category fragment. Returns each match with its kind, selector, category, and source file - the starting point for get_api, get_slots, get_theme_tokens, get_di_tokens, and get_story_example.

query.description: A name, selector, or category fragment, e.g. "select" or "cngx-chip".

version.description: Optional cngx version to ground the answer against, e.g. "0.2.0". Omit to answer from the bundled snapshot offline; a non-bundled version fetches that release snapshot via gh, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe).

tools.name: list_components
tools.title: List cngx components, directives, and services
tools.description: Enumerate every cngx component, directive, and injectable service as a compact summary ({ name, kind, selector, category, lib }), sorted by name. Optionally filter by `lib` (exact lib name, e.g. "common") and/or `kind` ("component" | "directive" | "injectable"); omit both for the full catalog. The deterministic browse complement to find_component's fuzzy search. An unmatched filter returns an empty list, not null.

lib.description: Exact owning lib name, e.g. "forms" or "common".

tools.name: get_api
tools.title: Get cngx component API
tools.description: Return a single component's, directive's, or injectable service's API surface - inputs, outputs, signal flag, host bindings, public methods, and description - by class name or selector. `result` is null when the name matches nothing, and `{ ambiguous: true, candidates }` when a selector matches several entries.

name.description: A component/directive/service class name or selector, e.g. "CngxSelect" or "cngx-select".

version.description: Optional cngx version to ground the answer against, e.g. "0.2.0". Omit to answer from the bundled snapshot offline; a non-bundled version fetches that release snapshot via gh, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe).

tools.name: get_slots
tools.title: Get cngx component template slots
tools.description: Return a component's projected template slots - each the slot directive selector name plus its one-line doc - by class name or selector. An empty slots array means the component projects no overridable slots. `result` is null when the name matches nothing, and `{ ambiguous: true, candidates }` when a selector matches several entries.

name.description: A component/directive class name or selector, e.g. "CngxSelect".

version.description: Optional cngx version to ground the answer against, e.g. "0.2.0". Omit to answer from the bundled snapshot offline; a non-bundled version fetches that release snapshot via gh, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe).

tools.name: get_theme_tokens
tools.title: Get cngx component theming tokens
tools.description: Return a component's theming tokens (the CSS custom properties it exposes) and its theme overview, by class name or selector. An empty themeTokens array means the component exposes none. `result` is null when the name matches nothing, and `{ ambiguous: true, candidates }` when a selector matches several entries. For DI tokens, use get_di_tokens.

name.description: A component/directive class name or selector, e.g. "CngxSelect".

version.description: Optional cngx version to ground the answer against, e.g. "0.2.0". Omit to answer from the bundled snapshot offline; a non-bundled version fetches that release snapshot via gh, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe).

tools.name: get_di_tokens
tools.title: Get cngx DI tokens
tools.description: Return the top-level DI injection tokens, optionally filtered by a name fragment. Omit the argument for the full list. For a component's theming tokens, use get_theme_tokens.

query.description: A DI-token name fragment, e.g. "SELECT". Omit for all DI tokens.

version.description: Optional cngx version to ground the answer against, e.g. "0.2.0". Omit to answer from the bundled snapshot offline; a non-bundled version fetches that release snapshot via gh, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe).

tools.name: get_config
tools.title: Get a cngx configuration cascade
tools.description: Return a config surface: the CNGX_<X>_CONFIG token, its co-located provider functions, the with* feature functions, and the resolution-priority ordering. Accepts a config token name (CNGX_SELECT_CONFIG), a config stem (select), or best-effort a component/directive name (CngxCombobox -> CNGX_SELECT_CONFIG). `result` is null when the input maps to no config token, and `{ ambiguous: true, candidates }` when a component selector matches several entries.

name.description: A config token (CNGX_SELECT_CONFIG), a stem (select), or a component name (CngxSelect).

version.description: Optional cngx version to ground the answer against, e.g. "0.2.0". Omit to answer from the bundled snapshot offline; a non-bundled version fetches that release snapshot via gh, or over HTTPS when gh is missing or fails (fail-safe).

tools.name: get_story_example
tools.title: Get cngx example URLs
tools.description: Return a component's runnable example URLs (public documentation links a consumer can open), plus a StackBlitz URL when one exists. Playground entries are repo-internal source references, not openable links. `result` is null when the name matches nothing, and `{ ambiguous: true, candidates }` when a selector matches several entries.

name.description: A component/directive class name or selector, e.g. "CngxSelect".

tools.name: migrate_usage
tools.title: Diff two cngx releases
tools.description: Return a structured API delta between two cngx releases: removed / renamed / signature-changed components, inputs, outputs, slots, and DI tokens. `to` defaults to the bundled snapshot version. A version other than the bundled one is fetched from the GitHub Release assets via `gh`, or over HTTPS when `gh` is missing or fails; no network or an absent asset returns a typed error result ({ ok: false, reason }), never a throw. A malformed version returns reason `invalid-version` before any fetch.

from.description: The cngx version to upgrade FROM, e.g. "0.1.0" (without the leading "v").

to.description: The cngx version to upgrade TO. Defaults to the bundled snapshot version.
